name: Cape EMS Berhad
summary: Cape EMS Berhad functions as an investment holding enterprise, specializing in comprehensive electronics manufacturing services (EMS) for clients across Asia, the Americas, and Europe. Their industrial electronics offerings encompass a wide array of wireless communication devices, including point-to-point and point-to-multiple-port antenna systems, interface and gateway solutions, and microwave antennas. The company also produces utility data collection apparatus like gateway devices, repeaters, remote readers, and transceivers, alongside point-of-sale (POS) terminals, LED lighting products, digital vending machines, and portable power banks. Within the consumer electronics sector, Cape EMS Berhad manufactures household appliances such as cordless vacuum cleaners, as well as various electronic cigarettes, featuring both POD-based models and disposable vape sticks. Beyond its core EMS activities, the firm engages in aluminum die casting services and the distribution of electronic products and associated services. Furthermore, it supplies critical parts and components, including lithium batteries, cables, and wires, alongside plastic elements like enclosures and mechanical parts, and metal components such as enclosures and antennas. The company, initially known as EMS Manufacturing (M) Berhad, was established in 1999 and is headquartered in Senai, Malaysia.
